sql: SELECT races.name FROM results INNER JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId INNER JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton' AND results.rank IS NOT NULL ORDER BY results.rank ASC LIMIT 1
